value.rationale: The geometry transition from obligatorily adjacent two particles on a triangle to possible separation on a square produces an exact qualitative sign change in event-count noise. Both models have unique optimal reversal rates determined globally by explicit polynomial equations. This resolves a natural two-geometry boundary for active hard-core transport, not an arbitrary chosen statistic or unmotivated finite sample.
